title: NP-completeness of serialized 3-CNF satisfiability
statement: Let $\mathrm{SAT}_3$ be the language of bit strings whose decoded CNF formula is satisfiable and has at most three literals in every clause. This language is NP-complete: it belongs to NP, and every language in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
replaced: The language $\mathrm{3SAT}$ of serialized satisfiable CNF formulas with at most three literals per clause is $\mathrm{NP}$-complete: it belongs to $\mathrm{NP}$ and every language in $\mathrm{NP}$ polynomial-time many-one reduces to it.
